FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 209
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/01/2025
Senate Bill 209 as introduced would decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
estimated maximum of $6 million annually, beginning in tax year 2026, by requiring the
Department of Revenue to adjust the dollar figure caps for certain items exempt under the
current sales tax holidays (Severe Weather Preparedness and Back-to-School) every five years,
beginning in 2026, based on the change in the Consumer Price Index.
This bill would also decrease receipts to local governments by an undetermined amount
dependent on which localities have adopted, or will adopt, the existing sales tax holidays, the
sales of tax-exempt products within those localities, and the applicable local rates.
